paper_metadata.title: A novel AlMoNbHfTi refractory high-entropy alloy with superior ductility

evidence.quote: Here, two novel single-phase body-centered cubic (BCC) structured Al5MoxNb36Hf13Ti46-x (x = 5, 7 at%, marked as Mo5 and Mo7) RHEAs with excellent room-temperature ductility and low density (7.53–7.64 g/cm3) were designed and prepared by tailoring the Mo content.

The button-like RHEA ingots with a nominal composition of Al5MoxNb36Hf13Ti46-x (x = 5, 7 at%) were prepared by vacuum-arc melting in a water-cooled copper mold with raw materials having a high purity of at least 99.9 wt%. The furnace chamber was filled with high-purity argon gas to prevent oxidation. A Ti ingot was melted to absorb the residual oxygen in the furnace chamber. Each ingot was remelted and flipped at least five times to ensure chemical homogeneity.

The button-like RHEA ingots with a nominal composition of Al5MoxNb36Hf13Ti46-x (x = 5, 7 at%) were prepared by vacuum-arc melting in a water-cooled copper mold with raw materials having a high purity of at least 99.9 wt%. The furnace chamber was filled with high-purity argon gas to prevent oxidation. A Ti ingot was melted to absorb the residual oxygen in the furnace chamber. Each ingot was remelted and flipped at least five times to ensure chemical homogeneity.
Some of the ingots were cold-rolled for a 70% thickness reduction, followed by recrystallization annealing in a muffle furnace at 1173 K for 30 min.
